articles.title: Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian in Gaza City
articles.summary: Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian in Gaza City An Israeli drone strike on a civilian vehicle in Gaza City killed one Palestinian and injured several others on Sunday, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported, citing local sources. The strike hit Al-Aqsa Street in the Tel al-Hawa industrial area, southwest of Gaza City. The dead and injured were taken to Al-Shifa Hospital, the report said. The reported killing brings the Palestinian death toll from Israel's military offensive in Gaza since 7 October 2023 to 74,018, with 175,079 injured, according to Palestinian medical sources.
